scope.market: UAE Toyota Yaris Sedan 2026 offer and first paid-demand validation

patterns.mechanic: Live UAE listings place advertised 2026 Yaris offers near AED 55,000, including original-paint or new-condition claims, so an AED 54,000 repaired vehicle without verified warranty lacks a clear price reason to inquire.
examples: Dubizzle live 2026 Yaris results included a 4,000 km listing at AED 54,000, an original-paint 16,000 km listing at AED 55,000, and brand-new GCC offers from about AED 58,000.
DubiCars reported used 2026 Yaris listings starting around AED 55,000.
Toyota UAE listed the official 2026 base model from AED 64,900.
limitations: Listings are asking prices, not completed transaction prices.
Trim, warranty, seller type and condition differ.

patterns.mechanic: Because the vehicle has repaired damage, the creative must pair the lower advertised price with factual disclosure and invite inspection rather than imply accident-free or perfect condition.
examples: The business's own Yaris video states the headlight and bumper were replaced with original parts and the hood was repaired and repainted.
limitations: The official police/insurance accident record was not obtained.
No independent inspection or paint-depth report is available.

patterns.mechanic: Use one direct WhatsApp action so every conversation can be attributed and qualified.
examples: Existing business Instagram already routes prospects toward direct conversation.
Prior repository market research found WhatsApp repeatedly used by UAE dealers as a low-friction endpoint.
limitations: Adoption does not prove conversion performance.
Response speed and sales handling can dominate results.

weak_patterns.mechanic: Advertising the vehicle as nearly new without disclosing known repair facts may create low-quality inquiries and damage trust when buyers discover the repairs.
examples: The vehicle's low mileage coexists with disclosed front-area repairs.
limitations: The exact severity and official accident classification remain unknown.

weak_patterns.mechanic: Spending the first small budget on two variants would divide an already limited sample before baseline qualified-lead viability is known.
examples: Recent account organic posts produced no attributable actions; historical paid conversation totals are not verified as qualified WhatsApp leads.
limitations: A later A/B test may be appropriate after baseline economics and tracking are known.

buyer_signals.signal: Price relative to new and original-paint alternatives

test_candidates.hypothesis: A truthful single Yaris offer at AED 51,900 can produce qualified WhatsApp conversations within a small fixed paid pilot because it creates a visible price gap while preserving trust through repair disclosure.
test_candidates.mechanism: Lead with the exact vehicle, year, GCC status, mileage and AED 51,900 price; disclose repaired front-area damage plainly; use one click-to-WhatsApp CTA.
test_candidates.change: Replace the prior AED 54,000 offer treatment with one baseline creative at AED 51,900 and measure qualified demand before funding an A/B test.
controls: No warranty, accident-free, original-paint, finance or perfect-condition claims
test_candidates.suggested_kpi: Qualified WhatsApp conversations and viewing/test-drive appointments attributable to the Yaris pilot
